Subject: Gym direct debit taken TWICE after I cancelled it

Hi there,

I cancelled my direct debit to Corefield Fitness in your app on the evening of Friday 2nd October. The app showed it as cancelled straight away and I have a screenshot. Despite that, £42.99 went out on Monday 5th and then ANOTHER £42.99 on the 12th. The gym says I'm 'still in my notice period' and that it's between me and my bank.

I cancelled the membership with them by email on 30/09 as well. I don't see how you can let a company take money when the direct debit isn't there any more. I'd like both payments (£85.98) put back in my account and confirmation they can't take anything else.

You can reach me on 07700 900 238 if easier, I'm not always near my landline.

Thanks
Bex

Rebecca Osei
